title: AI 要跨越盧比孔河了嗎？自我成長的 AI 離我們多遠 (上集)
notes: Topic-aligned paraphrases from the provider-returned Chinese (Taiwan) manual caption track. Timings refer to relevant spoken statements, not independently verified slide-transition frames. topic_alignment.paraphrase: Introduces Anthropic's April 2026 automated alignment researcher work and links its shorter announcement and detailed research article.

Introduces weak-to-strong alignment using OpenAI's December 2023 work: weaker models supervise stronger pretrained student models as a tractable analogue for the difficulty of humans supervising more capable AI.

Explains the weak-supervisor, weak-to-strong student and strong-supervision reference bars across three evaluation settings. Emphasizes designing training so that the student need not copy every weak-supervisor error; the source paper defines the actual losses and metrics.

Explains Anthropic's researcher agents designing learning procedures for students trained with weak supervision. Researchers exchange experiment information and improve on the specified human reference methods. This is not evidence that Opus trained a stronger version of itself.

States the lecturer's May 2026 assessment that the examples have not established the proposed recursive-improvement threshold. The 2028 statement is presented as a forecast from an earlier commentary, not as an observed result or as a November 2026 update.
